title: Sources: ByteDance boosted its cloud offering via more sales hires and lower prices; IDC: it had 13% of China's AI cloud market in H1 2025, behind Alibaba's 23% (Eleanor Olcott/Financial Times)
summary: Eleanor Olcott / Financial Times: Sources: ByteDance boosted its cloud offering via more sales hires and lower prices; IDC: it had 13% of China's AI cloud market in H1 2025, behind Alibaba's 23% — Deep discounts, vast data and bespoke AI agents fuel new challenge in China's multibillion-dollar enterprise market
